text: Over the last 30 days, several visitors reported issues with crowding, noting that the library felt very busy even during early entry times, which made it difficult to fully experience the exhibits. Some found the timed entry system confusing, especially regarding the requirement to purchase tickets online in advance, as tickets cannot be bought on site. Parking was also a common concern, with limited availability due to large vehicles occupying multiple spaces. A number of reviews criticized the heavy use of AI in interactive exhibits and mentioned a lack of clear signage or directions inside the library. Despite these concerns, the architecture and overall information provided were frequently mentioned positively.
